source.notes: Emre Kalem's source STL ZIP and eight-plate P1S profile were downloaded on 2026-08-18. The published profile is 0.20 mm, 3 walls, 10% grid infill, manual normal supports, automatic brim, 1157 g, and 29.7 h. It was not submitted directly: each plate was exported to preserve the designer's object count and orientation, then rearranged and resliced for H2D Pro with the validated 02.07.01.62 profiles. Automatic normal support replaces the profile's painted manual support after STL export. Plates 1-3 use orange PLA; plates 4-8 use white PLA. The designer states that the firmware/software is still under development.

learnings: MakerWorld's H2D Pro compatibility filter downloaded the same P1S-authored 3MF (identical SHA-256), so compatibility metadata is not evidence of an H2D-native slice.
Exporting each original plate to transformed STL files preserved the designer's count and orientation; H2D Pro could then rearrange those objects without reorienting them.
Painted manual supports are lost by STL export. Normal automatic support at the designer's 30-degree threshold increased the H2D estimate from 1157 g to 1200.79 g.
The live AMS had insufficient material for a single-color 1.2 kg job but enough orange and white PLA for a plate-level two-color split without purge waste.
